tasks.title: Implement order state machine
tasks.description: Create `apps/api/src/domain/state-machine.ts` with pure `canTransition(from, to)` / `assertTransition`. Allowed: `created→paid→delivering→delivered`; `created→payment_failed`; `paid|delivering→out_of_stock|delivery_failed`; recoverable `out_of_stock|delivery_failed→delivering` via retry-delivery only; stuck `delivering` resumable. Terminal `delivered` and `payment_failed` reject further payment/fulfillment side effects. Import OrderStatus from enums. Covers F6.

tasks.title: Implement payment apply policy
tasks.description: Create `apps/api/src/domain/payment-policy.ts` with pure `applyPaymentEvent(...)`. First durable payment outcome wins: ignore `failed` after `paid`/`delivered`; ignore `paid` after `payment_failed`; duplicate `event_id` returns flag `duplicate` and is a no-op. Unknown order is a buffer (not an apply). No I/O. Covers F3/F5.

tasks.title: Implement fulfillment retry/fallback policy
tasks.description: Create `apps/api/src/domain/fulfillment-policy.ts` with pure `nextFulfillmentAction(...)` and request-id helpers: A uses `req_{orderId}-A` on every retry; B uses new `req_{orderId}-B`; never mix providers on one request_id. Timeout ≠ failure (retry same request_id on A). Fallback B only after A retries exhausted or A hard-down. Accept timeoutMs and A retry count as numbers. At most one successful issue per order. Covers F7.

tasks.title: Define provider and persistence ports
tasks.description: Create `apps/api/src/domain/ports.ts` with interfaces only: `IssueProvider.issue({ requestId, sku, orderId })` → `{ status:'ok', requestId, code }` | `{ status:'error', reason }` | timeout; plus `InventoryPort`, `OrderPort`, `PaymentEventPort`. No implementations.
